capabilities: Draw timelines, family trees, maps and calendars from note properties
Paint and edit map territories, routes and borders
Track realms, dynasties, wars and occupations over time
Create and link notes with a quick creator and inspector
Export charts, a world book, a website and GEDCOM
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault graph or 3D universe view; it builds timelines, family trees, maps and calendars from notes that carry a type and a few properties.
extras: Written entirely by AI (Claude) and not reviewed line by line by a human developer; the README advises backing up the vault and notes that every change can be undone. Not yet in the community plugin list, so it is installed with BRAT or by hand. It reads and writes only the vault; the only network requests are real-world map tiles and images the notes link to.
problem: Notes about people, places and events hold everything needed for a history, family or campaign, but Obsidian shows them only as text and links, with no timelines, trees or maps.

relations.evidence: reads inline fields (born:: 1210), and exposes an API for queries
icon: LiCastle-style names work for map pins
set a template per note type; Templater commands are run
everything the Style Settings plugin used to offer, so it's no longer needed
Iconic by Holo (obsidian-iconic): icons on notes in the file explorer

summary: Worldbuilding suite that turns typed notes into timelines, family trees, maps, calendars and dynasty charts, and writes edits back to the notes.
